rowText: By eye, the maintainer -- The lit name readable at arm's length; the lit cell reads as a selection, not a warning; nothing clipped; in green (no character), gold (Ali G), purple (Shadowheart), grey (Astarion), pink (Fuu)

verdictSentence: Five screenshots taken, one per colour (green, gold, purple, grey, pink), each with the lit Main tab clearly in frame and the whole strip visible; the driver does not judge whether the colours read well, only captured them for the maintainer's own look.
